review_environment: Owner-private HTTPS preview containing the same three page assets. Final publication destination is GitHub Pages.

checks.name: Portfolio desktop and narrow-screen rendering
checks.observed: 1280 x 900 and 390 x 844 CSS-pixel viewports inspected. No document horizontal overflow. Navigation and worked-case links operated.

checks.name: Worked-case desktop layout and mathematical typography
checks.observed: Definition, reference calculation, editable scenario, charts, proposed programme and source sections inspected. Eight KaTeX expressions; zero KaTeX error elements.

checks.name: Reference scenario
checks.observed: Displayed design action 7.050 kN, Johansen resistance 10.026 kN, utilisation 0.703, instantaneous movement 0.557 mm and final movement 1.198 mm.

checks.name: M14 washer detailing conflict
checks.observed: Both 100 mm loaded ends met the selected 98 mm minimum. Fixed 40 x 4 mm washers failed the selected 42 x 4.2 mm minima. Conflict was visible beside the component result.

checks.name: M16 preset and compatible geometry
checks.observed: Fixed-detail preset reported both loaded-end and washer conflicts. Changing overlap to 240 mm, first end to 120 mm, washers to 48 x 4.8 mm cleared the selected geometry conflicts; no overall design pass was shown.

checks.name: Permanent-only action envelope
checks.observed: Gk 6 kN and Qk 0 displayed permanent-only action 8.100 kN, resistance 7.520 kN and utilisation 1.077, with a component-resistance exceedance.

checks.name: Prescribed free play
checks.observed: The 1.5 mm free-play preset displayed final movement 2.698 mm and an explicit exceedance of the chosen 2.000 mm study budget.

checks.name: Invalid-input hiding and recovery
checks.observed: Blank and negative bolt diameters hid the current results and disabled the result download. Restore reference recovered the baseline. Fixed reference calculations remained separately labelled.

checks.name: Thinner-member preset and downloaded result
checks.observed: 35 mm outer members displayed utilisation 0.774. Actual browser JSON download independently matched Python evaluate(downloaded inputs): 132 numerical and 83 string values, 31 objects, 11 arrays, zero differences. Download SHA256 44a8fdee3a2c8d3c5770e00f1423a50c71be45dee608ebc0e7345a8f761f3fcd.

checks.name: Keyboard access and visible focus
checks.observed: Tab advanced between labelled numeric controls. Enter activated Restore reference. Focus outline was blue and approximately 2.7 CSS pixels at the observed scaling.

checks.name: Narrow-screen chart containment after correction
checks.observed: Initial 390 px viewport produced 459 px document overflow from sensitivity grid items. Added min-width:0/max-width:100% containment. Real-browser retest: 375 px document width within the 390 px viewport, 293 px chart cards, chart contents scroll within local regions. M16 conflict and keyboard reset also operated at narrow width.

checks.name: Legacy facade baseline, recalculation and recovery
checks.observed: Baseline 6.037 kN connection component, 0.5783 kN whole-panel seismic action and 45 x 90 mm last fire section. M16 recalculated to 7.15 kN. Zero diameter hid the result with an input error; reset restored the baseline. Desktop and narrow layout had no document horizontal overflow.

checks.name: Legacy fire and racking applicability controls
checks.observed: Three-face exposure changed the last section to Exhausted. Setting no-openings prerequisite to Not satisfied changed racking applicability to INAPPLICABLE and retained Not established resistance.

checks.name: Legacy individual equation runner
checks.observed: Selected and ran timber_modes fixture 27 through the actual UI. It displayed governing mode d and per-fastener total 7875.7351942646255 N.

checks.name: Linked report download
checks.observed: Downloaded the linked eight-page PDF through the browser. SHA256 a33b5f02fb9346f8161ba89c94e919693cc8a5b998817681301db231bc21b589 exactly matches the released report. Separate PDF visual/source QA is retained.

checks.name: Captured browser console and maths errors
checks.observed: Captured warning/error logs were empty in the reviewed legacy page and fresh corrected case page. Zero KaTeX error elements in the reviewed pages.

scope: Selected real-browser visual, keyboard and interaction checks. Separate from numerical source verification, physical validation, product qualification and complete design approval. This is not an exhaustive browser or accessibility certification.
fixed_issue: Sensitivity grid min-content width caused narrow-screen document overflow. The corrected page was redeployed privately and reviewed again before GitHub publication.
